cohort: The study included 49 women with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) who conceived via assisted reproduction technology (ART) due to female infertility, matched with three control groups: IBD patients who conceived spontaneously, women using ART, and women who conceived spontaneously.
finding: Patients with inflammatory bowel disease undergoing assisted reproduction technology have comparable pregnancy outcomes to women using ART and to patients with IBD with spontaneous pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women in the IBD-ART group had decreased rates of vaginal delivery (34.7% vs 57.1%, p = 0.032) and higher rates of elective CS (32.7% vs 14.3%, p = 0.048) in comparison to the healthy spontaneous conception group (H-SP), but comparable rates to both IBD-SP and H-ART groups.
